bootstrap.over: held-out images, the floor held fixed

airplane.note: Airplane itself has no verified negative

animals.note: the one class whose absence means no animal; leaf classes are not added, so an image verified only as Dog is not scored for this label

overrides: the mapping is not the committed mapping
the corpus manifest is not the committed one
scoreUnit: cosine of L2-normalised image and text vectors, each artifact's own two towers

truth.name: Open Images
truth.scoredOver: per label, its sample: the first 300 images on which it is verified present and the first 300 on which it is verified absent, in the selection's order. No other image is in any figure of that label against truth, whether the label was verified on it or not. Agreement between artifacts and firing rates are over every image, as they need no truth
